summary: Full regression of the black+blue premium upgrade. BACKEND: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py 5/5 PASS against public URL (GET /api/, POST /api/contact + GET persistence, 422 on invalid email, 422 on empty fields, resume PDF served). FRONTEND (public preview URL, desktop 1440/1920, tablet 768, mobile 390): 0 console errors, 0 page errors, ZERO horizontal overflow at all three breakpoints (scrollWidth == clientWidth). HERO: eyebrow 'Muhd Afif — Interactive Multimedia Student', hero-title = 'Multimedia Designer' (CSS-uppercased, two mask lines), hero-view-work scrolls to #work (scrollY 2050), hero-download-resume is an <a target=_blank> to the https resume PDF, 'Scroll to Explore' cue visible on desktop. NAVBAR: sticky; after scroll gains bg-[#050505]/70 + backdrop-blur-xl + blue border. All 5 nav links smooth-scroll; scroll-spy verified EXCLUSIVE - scrolling to about/work/skills/contact underlines exactly one link (About/Work/Skills/Contact) with blue underline at full width. nav-lets-talk scrolls to #contact. Tablet 768 correctly shows the desktop nav (md breakpoint) and hides the hamburger; mobile 390 hamburger opens/closes, nav-mobile-link-work and nav-mobile-lets-talk both navigate and close the menu. CUSTOM CURSOR: desktop only - element present, body cursor 'none', body.hide-cursor set, pointer-events:none; on hovering a project card the variant switches to 'view' (76px ring with 'VIEW' text). At 768 and 390 there is NO cursor element, hide-cursor absent, body cursor 'auto', and elementFromPoint over a card returns the card's own overlay (nothing intercepting taps) - mobile/tablet clicks open the modal fine. SELECTED WORK: exactly 4 projects (muar-river-cruise, ar-cooking-guide, nacho-macho, poster-design). Hover gives real 3D tilt (matrix3d on card), image zoom (scale 1.048), blue border glow and arrow badge. All 4 modals open + close via project-detail-close, body overflow lock released each time; Muar still renders project-video, gallery images all load (naturalWidth>0: 4/4/3/4). Modals also open/close correctly at 768 and 390. SKILLS: skill-group-design/video/interactive all present; 8 software cards (photoshop, illustrator, premiere-pro, after-effects, figma, unity, indesign, canva). EDUCATION: 2 education-item. RESUME CTA: heading "Let's create something exceptional.", resume-cta-download <a target=_blank> to resume URL. CONTACT: heading 'Let's Work Together.'; contact-email/linkedin/resume/location all render; empty submit shows error toast 'Please fill in all fields.' and issues NO POST; filled submit POSTs to /api/contact, shows success toast and clears the form (verified on both desktop and mobile). FOOTER: logo, 'Multimedia Designer', Email/LinkedIn/Resume, '© 2026 Muhd Afif'. Scroll reveals fire (skill groups reach opacity 1 on enter). No blocking issues found.

issues: useScrollTo lands sections at top = 72px while the navbar is 80px tall (h-20), so the top ~8px of a section sits behind the translucent header. Barely visible because of the blur, but bumping the offset to 80-96 would be cleaner.
Graphic Design desktop masonry (lg:columns-3) is lopsided with only 4 posters.
Graphic Design hero poster is duplicated as gallery item 1.
Resume PDF filename still reads 'MUHAMMAD AFIF BIN AZHAR' while the site brands 'Muhd Afif'.

action_items: No functional fixes required - the black+blue upgrade preserved all content, testids, routes and the contact integration.
Optional: increase the scroll-to offset from 72 to >=80 so section tops are not tucked under the 80px navbar.
Optional carry-overs: rebalance the 4-poster desktop masonry, de-duplicate hero/gallery[0], rename the resume PDF.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail still reads project.gallery / project.tools unconditionally - a future project missing either key will throw. Add optional chaining with [] fallback.

CustomCursor computes 'fine pointer && innerWidth>=1024' once on mount with no resize listener; resizing a desktop window below 1024 keeps the custom cursor active (and vice versa). Add a resize/matchMedia change listener if that matters.

Magnetic wraps CTAs in a motion.div; it is inline-block only where a className is passed (ResumeCTA). In Hero the wrappers are block-level divs inside a flex row so it works, but passing an explicit class keeps intent obvious.

useActiveSection only sets on isIntersecting and never clears, so the last matched id persists in the dead zones between sections - acceptable behaviour, but a single-active reduce over entries would be more deterministic.
seed_data_creation: Two contact messages posted for integration verification: TEST_QA/qa_test@example.com (desktop) and TEST_Mobile/qa_mobile@example.com (mobile), plus TEST_User from pytest.
test_credentials: None required - public portfolio, no auth. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified the premium black+blue upgrade end to end. Everything in the review request passes; only cosmetic items remain (scroll offset 72 vs 80px navbar, 4-poster masonry balance, hero/gallery duplication, resume PDF filename). Useful techniques: read computed width of the nav button's inner <span> to detect the active blue underline; read document.querySelector('.mix-blend-difference') plus body.classList.contains('hide-cursor') to assert the custom cursor is desktop-only; use elementFromPoint at the card centre on mobile to prove nothing intercepts taps; the desktop nav (not the hamburger) is what shows at exactly 768px.
